chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu al-Maghra', from one of his companions, from Uqba ibn Bashir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

We entered upon him, so he called for dates, and we ate them. Then he increased it for us from it, then he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I love the man,' or he said: 'I like the man who is fond of dates.'

key_terms.تَمْرٍ: Dates (the fruit of the date palm)
key_terms.تَمْرِيّاً: One who is fond of/eats dates

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (peace be upon him) say about loving someone who eats dates?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) conveys the Prophet’s affection for the 'tamariyy'—those who frequently consume dates—linking dietary preference to spiritual virtue. This reflects the broader Shia emphasis on the Sunnah of the Prophet, where simple acts like eating dates are elevated to acts of emulation and health, often associated with the Prophet’s physical strength and spiritual purity.
